To explain a new repair policy

Questions refer to the following speech.

Thank you all for coming to the reopening of the Calloway Natural History Museum. When we closed eighteen months ago, many people asked why a museum would shut its doors just to replace its heating and cooling system. The answer is simple: many of our specimens—some over a century old—are extremely sensitive to changes in temperature and humidity. The new system keeps conditions stable to within one degree. That investment also made something else possible. For the first time, we can display our collection of pressed plants, which until now had been kept in storage. I'd especially like to thank the volunteers who catalogued over six thousand items during the closure. Without them, we would not be opening today. Now, please join me in the main hall.
question: Why was the museum closed?
choices: The whole collection was moved elsewhere.
The building was expanded with a new wing.
It temporarily lost its government funding.
A climate control system was replaced.
answer: A climate control system was replaced.
explanation: 冷暖房（温湿度管理）システムの交換のため閉館していた。
